data.name: Dahhaak
data.gender_notes: Dahhaak is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'dhh' which means 'to crush' or 'to be powerful'. In Islamic tradition, it is often associated with the power and might of Allah. The name Dahhaak carries the meaning “Crushing, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dahhaak usually hope their child will grow to embody crushing, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Dahhaak represents the inner strength and courage to overcome challenges and obstacles in life.
data.etymology: Dahhaak belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Crushing, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dahhaak total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
